verdict: Coinbase's revenue more than doubled from a year ago to $1.64B on the post-ETF crypto rally, and a $737M paper gain on the crypto it holds turned that into $1.18B of net income — a 72% net margin.

otherDetail: A $650M gain on crypto Coinbase holds as an investment and $46M of other income, less $19M of interest expense — plus the $84M net of operating lines moved here from operating expenses (an $86M gain on crypto held for operations, less $2M of other operating expense; see the note under the chart): a net $761M.
follow100Note: Rows may not add exactly due to rounding. The 'Other income' row includes the $84M net of operating gains (crypto held for operations, net of other operating expense) that Coinbase reports inside operating expenses, moved here to match the chart — see the note under the chart.

takeaways.title: Revenue more than doubled
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 112% from a year ago to $1.64B as the January launch of spot bitcoin ETFs pulled traders back: total trading volume hit $312B, and transaction revenue alone was $1.08B, up 187%.

takeaways.title: Paper crypto gains did the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: A new accounting rule (ASU 2023-08) let Coinbase mark the crypto it holds to market prices, adding $737M of pre-tax gains — $650M on crypto held for investment and $86M on crypto held for operations. Most of it is unrealized, and it made up the bulk of the quarter's $1.18B net income.

takeaways.title: Adjusted EBITDA topped $1B
takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA was $1,014M — 62% of revenue — as costs grew far more slowly than revenue. Subscription and services revenue, the steadier half of the business, rose 41% to $511M, led by $197M of stablecoin revenue.

sources.label: Official earnings release — Q1 2024 shareholder letter (SEC EDGAR)

footerNote: Coinbase reports no gross-profit line; 'Transaction expense' — the direct cost of processing trades — is shown as cost of revenue. Coinbase also reports two lines inside operating expenses that the chart shows in the 'other income' step instead: an $86M gain on crypto held for operations and $2M of other operating expense — a net $84M gain. The chart's operating profit is therefore $676M rather than the reported $760M — net income is unchanged at $1,176M. Figures are from Coinbase's Q1 2024 shareholder letter (Exhibit 99.1) and Form 10-Q.
